title: The Add site form records each page an opening reached (wizard.step), and /login records a visit from a link with utm_* (login.visited) only from its own script
steps: S1: POST /api/sites/wizard {wizardId, step} signed out; with no id; with steps off the list ('create:nowhere', 'Create:design', 42, ''); then 'start:source', 'import:address', 'import:access', 'import:address'.
S2: For every page createStepIds(true), the five import pages and the business page, wizardStepName gives a name; check each is in WIZARD_STEPS.
S3: The add-site client: wizardStep(id, step) answered 400, then one whose fetch throws.
S4: loginPage with a source and without one.

S5: POST /login/visit with Origin = own origin and utm fields; with another Origin; with Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site; with no utm field; with Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin; then 31 visits from one client address.
expect: S1: 401; 400 INVALID_WIZARD_ID; 400 INVALID_WIZARD_STEP for each bad step; three wizard.step rows {wizard_id, step} (the repeated page is one); no wizard.opened row.
S2: every name is on WIZARD_STEPS.
S3: POST /api/sites/wizard {wizardId, step}; nothing awaited, nothing thrown.

S4: the page with a source carries fetch('/login/visit') guarded by sessionStorage 'tracy-login-visit' and the cleaned utm fields; the page without a source also sends fetch('/login/visit'), with an empty body (since #147: a direct visit).

S5: 204 and one login.visited {source, medium, content} with account_id null; 403 twice; 204 and a row {} (since #147 a visit with no source is a direct visit, not dropped); 204 and another row; the 31st answers 429.

selectors.files: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/route.js (WIZARD_STEPS, /api/sites/wizard); apps/tracy-web/src/identity/route.js (/login/visit), identity/pages.js (visitScript); packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/client/create.ts (wizardStep), wizard-usage.mjs, wizard.tsx, import-wizard.tsx

evidence: tracy-marketing strategy/launch/2026-10-16-tong-ket-tuan-beta/ket-qua-tuan-2026-10-23.md sections 8F and 9: half of the openings of the Add site form are left in every channel, page unknown; forum, helpdesk, support@ and YouTube have no visit counts
fence: Usage never stands in the customer's way: the form and the sign-in page never wait; a visit is counted only by the page's own script and only from its own origin, so link scanners and other sites cannot add rows

tests: POST /api/sites/wizard with step records one wizard.step per id and page
every page the Add site form can name is on the WIZARD_STEPS list
the wizard tells tracy-web which page an opening reached
the login page tells /login/visit once per tab
POST /login/visit keeps one cleaned source per visit
POST /login/visit stops at the hourly cap
